name: POLYPORUS PINICOLA
fever_symptoms: Great lassitude, congestion of head, with vertigo, face hot and flushed, prickling sensation all over; restless at night from pain in wrists and knee; rheumatic pains; profuse perspiration. Headache about 10 am, with pain in back, ankles and legs increasing until 3 pm, then gradually better.

source.title: POLYPORUS PINICOLA - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
